Be sure to connect the Y/GN wire to the N.O. terminals of both of the ROTATE button switches for player 2 (right player). Similarly, connect the W/GN wire to the N.O. terminals of both of the ROTATE button switches for player 1 (left player). Connect the common terminals of the switches to one of the BK/W Wires.

After the installation is complete: Some game cabinets with switching power supplies exhibit video noise interference. If your cabinet produces this effect, try installing a .1 pF, 50 volt (or greater) ceramic capacitor between the earth ground and logic ground terminals on the switching power supply.
